/HOME ProPS / tribox
===================
wiki:home, wiki:devices, wiki:devices/ysi600r

The ProPS is a UV-Spectrometer controlled by the tribox. The tribox calculates from the spectrometry the
concentration of NO<sup>3-</sup>, TOC, TSS<sub>eq</sub> and other varaibles with a program called LSA.

## Maintanance

Every week:

 - Remove ProPS from its holding using a hexagon socket key size 4mm
 - Clean window with Aceton
 - Put ProPS back in place

## How to replace the ProPS sensor
 - empty the water inside the sensor with "BEmpty" command
 - unplug the connection cable
 - open the nut with wrench (Fig. 1)
 - open 8 screws on the black box (holder) with allen key
 - pull out the caps from two sides of the box
 - open the white cap 
 - pull out the sensor and replace it with the new one
 - the inlet hole on the sensor needs to be matched with the hole on the holder (Fig. 2)
 - close the holder caps
 - replace the white cap
 - close the nut
 - plug in the cable
 - write down the serial number (Fig. 3)
 - upload the new sensor to the tribox
